horizons.QE1: quarter-end issue, target next quarter, news of the issue quarter (FI6-N Lead 1)
horizons.OP1: operational issue (end of 2nd month), target next quarter, news of the last complete quarter (FI9 Lead 1)
horizons.OP1w: operational issue, target next quarter, news of the 90 days before issue
horizons.OP0: operational issue, target current quarter (nowcast), news of the last complete quarter
horizons.QE2: quarter-end issue, target two quarters ahead (FI6-N Lead 2)

protocol.model: FI6 LightGBM change model ('reg', monotone constraints); class = p >= 0.5; no tuning

decisions.news_improves_probability_quality: Brier(Government + news) - Brier(Government only): 95% block-bootstrap CI below 0; Bonferroni over the 5 horizons (99% CI) reported and required for a 'robust' claim
decisions.news_improves_accuracy_or_recall: McNemar p < 0.05 on correct classifications, or recall difference with a bootstrap CI excluding 0
decisions.news_beyond_latest_reading: Brier(News + latest reading) and Brier(Government + news) vs naive persistence: 95% CI below 0
decisions.stable: Brier difference (news vs no news) negative in each era with news (2016-2020, 2021-2026) and 95% CI below 0 without the FI7 sawtooth quarters
decisions.operationally_meaningful: a news configuration that passes the FI7 reliability rule AND beats naive persistence (95% CI below 0) at that horizon

protocol.known_before_lock: FI6-N results (QE1 news gain on Brier/AUC; QE2 borderline) and FI7/FI9 OP1 ablations (no gain)
